findings.title: claimBuyback is sender-bound — decide before deployment
findings.consequence: every claimant needs native gas at the address in their leaf; under Path A that is the derived pocket, an address that by construction has never held anything
findings.why_time_boxed: the Distributor is immutable once deployed; if it ships sender-bound that campaign is sender-bound forever, with no retrofit
findings.classification: a one-way door that is still open

findings.title: member_count is unchecked against contract law
anchors: BermRobinhoodDistributorV01.sol:396 memberCount is public pure returning only 50/100/300
findings.failure_mode: a roster built with any other value produces a root no proof can ever verify on-chain; nothing fails at compile, finalization or seal, and the first symptom is InvalidProof for every member after the root is immutable
findings.fix: assert member_count === {0:50,1:100,2:300}[cohort_id] in the compiler, and assert the constitution cohort_law agrees

findings.title: under-fill has no honest path, and it strands the finalizer
findings.cause: memberCount is fixed and count is inside the leaf, so a GRADUATION roster must contain exactly 100 leaves
findings.immediate: an under-filled cohort can only be finalized by padding with provably-unclaimable leaves, and that padding law is written nowhere
second_order: sealRoots() at :262 requires all three roots and all three evidence hashes non-zero
if FOMO never reaches 300 and no padding law exists, cohort 2 is never finalized
'after sealing, no privileged actor remains' never becomes true
findings.contradiction: BERMLAUNCH-SCOPE.md BL-07 and §16 rule that 'an unfilled cohort is a smaller cohort'; either the padding law is written down or that ruling is wrong
findings.fix: write the padding law: what occupies an unfilled slot, why it is provably unclaimable, how the explorer renders it, and that sealing is reachable regardless of fill

findings.title: RootsNotSealed is declared and never thrown
findings.fact: claimBuyback does not gate on rootsSealed
findings.opus_position: the contract is right and my own spec is wrong: enforcing RootsNotSealed would lock Founding claims behind cohorts that may never fill — F-03's failure mode with the money inside it
findings.owed_codex: remove the dead selector or use it
findings.owed_opus: correct BERMLAUNCH-SCOPE.md BL-11, which lists RootsNotSealed in its must-fail set

findings.title: the observer is one key with rotation disabled
findings.consequence: if that key is lost or compromised no further observation receipts can be produced, so GRADUATION and FOMO can never be finalized — landing in F-03's terminal state
findings.classification: disclosure, not necessarily wrong for a canary
findings.fix: rule on it, and disclose it in SOVEREIGNTY.md at the same rank as the Bags rows either way

findings.title: dead code retaining the closed vulnerability's shape
findings.fact: defined, called nowhere; it is the function that accepted caller-supplied observations
findings.risk: a dormant compiling copy of a closed bypass is a re-introduction hazard: a refactor that reaches for it restores C1–C9 without touching the guard that closed them
findings.fix: delete it, or move it to the test tree asserting it is unreachable from a production path

not_a_finding_but_unrecorded.title: cohort boundaries are hardcoded equal thirds of the community share
not_a_finding_but_unrecorded.headline: a Founding slot is 6x a Momentum slot — the conviction ladder as an actual figure

gasless_claim_proposal.why_not_fully_permissionless: harvest() and syncExternalDeposit() are permissionless because their destinations are immutable and no price is involved; claimBuyback executes a swap, so a permissionless caller would choose when the conversion happens and with what minTokensOut — a griefing surface
gasless_claim_proposal.proposed_signature: claimBuybackWithSig(uint8 cohortId, uint32 slotIndex, bytes32 npubRaw, address wallet, bytes32[] calldata proof, uint256 minTokensOut, uint256 deadline, uint256 nonce, bytes calldata signature)
design: EIP-712 domain bound to campaignId, block.chainid and address(this)
signed struct covers every parameter including minTokensOut and deadline
recovered signer MUST equal wallet — the same address the Merkle proof already commits to
a per-identity nonce prevents replay of a signature after a partial claim
proceeds go to wallet exactly as today; the submitter receives nothing
gasless_claim_proposal.no_new_authority: no trusted forwarder, no EIP-2771; the leaf address is already the verifying key and is already sealed in the root

mandatory_rules.reason: claimBuyback stays as-is; replacing it would make entitlement unreachable if no relayer ran — a sweep by neglect, which invariant 3 forbids
if the only working relayer is ours, claiming requires our permission, which invariant 4 forbids; the function must not check the caller at all

mandatory_rules.rule: gas is funded from the operating fee
mandatory_rules.reason: it exists to pay for service, is capped at 1000 bps and is immutable, so it cannot grow to swallow what it sponsors
mandatory_rules.forbidden: the community's 6000 bps, consistent with the UC-13 ruling

alternatives.appeal: sponsors the derived EOA with no contract change
alternatives.caveat: NOT VERIFIED that Robinhood chain supports it, and it grants the pocket more capability than the task needs
alternatives.verdict: worth checking, not worth depending on

alternatives.appeal: no contract change, works today, near-zero cost
alternatives.caveat: operational, heuristic, and fails for the person arriving in three years when nobody runs it
alternatives.verdict: acceptable stopgap, wrong foundation — the late arrival is precisely who this product exists for

gasless_claim_proposal.the_decision: if claimBuybackWithSig is not in the deployed bytecode it never can be; adding it costs a function and a nonce mapping now, omitting it costs nothing now and cannot be undone

opus_view_opinion_not_findings.disclaimer: judgement, to be argued with rather than implemented; contains no defect claims
opus_view_opinion_not_findings.what_this_pack_changed: the defect class that has dominated every review since the sealed R1 is closed at the right altitude — made structurally unreachable rather than patched instance by instance. What remains is two decisions (F-01, F-05), one missing law (F-03), one missing assertion (F-02), and two lines of cleanup (F-04, F-06). None is research; all are closable in days.

on_the_209.caveat: the matrix has not been read; this is a method for shrinking it, not a claim about its contents

members: the Bags claimers fixed at create_fee_config
partition_in_order.why: the only cases where being wrong is unrecoverable

partition_in_order.observation: the entire ncryptsec + signer-application + postMessage + ROR + rpIdFromOrigin block exists so that someone with no Nostr key can enroll; NIP-07 and NIP-46 are built and tested today

partition_in_order.question: is it a decision or a build?
partition_in_order.why: decisions cost an afternoon and usually unblock several cases each; builds cost weeks and usually unblock one
partition_in_order.opus_expectation: 133 is not 133 independent items but roughly five clusters plus a handful of unmade rulings

on_the_209.falsification_test: if partitioning the 209 this way does not collapse it substantially, the reframe is wrong — and that is worth knowing rather than politely adopting

recommended_order: rule on F-01 — the only item with a hard deadline attached to an irreversible event
close F-02 — two assertions against a silent permanent failure, the best effort-to-risk ratio on the page
write F-03's padding law — not code, a paragraph that stops it being invented under pressure
rule on F-05 and disclose it either way
delete F-06 and F-04's dead selector — minutes
then partition the 209 and re-cost what is left
opus_view_opinion_not_findings.would_not_defer: the fail-open defects are closed and must stay closed. If any later simplification reintroduces a path where caller-supplied data reaches a production compile, that is not a scope decision — it is invariant 2, and it is the credibility of everything else. The 209 partition is about deferring PLATFORM work; it is not about deferring correctness.
